entries.title: Psalms 97:1
segments: The LORD reigns; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of islands be glad.

entries.title: Psalms 97:2
segments: Clouds and darkness [are] all around Him; righteousness and judgment [are] the foundation of His throne.

entries.title: Psalms 97:3
segments: A fire goes before Him and burns up His enemies round about.

entries.title: Psalms 97:4
segments: His lightnings lit up the world; the earth saw and trembled.

entries.title: Psalms 97:5
segments: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the LORD of the whole earth.

entries.title: Psalms 97:6
segments: The heavens declare His righteousness, and all the people see His glory.

entries.title: Psalms 97:7
segments: All those who serve graven images [are] ashamed, those who boast themselves in idols; all gods bow down before Him.

entries.title: Psalms 97:8
segments: Zion heard and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of Your judgments, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 97:9
segments: For You, LORD, [are] high above all the earth; You are lifted on high far above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 97:10
segments: You who love the LORD, hate evil; He keeps the souls of His saints; He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 97:11
segments: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 97:12
segments: Rejoice in the LORD, righteous ones; and give thanks at the memory of His holiness.
